adjunct_claims.description: A unit may touch paths outside envelope(R) only when an explicit adjunct claim is recorded for this wave. Claims are fail-closed: absent claim = refuse.
rules: Adjunct leaves must be disjoint from every other open integ PR's claimed set.
Hub paths are never adjuncts — they use hub waivers only.
Concurrent-safe exemption paths do not require adjunct claims when the edit is append-only under the registered exemption.
Cargo.lock may travel only with the integ that changed workspace membership (hub rule), never as a silent adjunct.

judgment_template.rule: Path/name changes require judgment_status=done. Keeping or replacing an existing pattern at ROOT scope requires lenses_applied=all-16 and non-empty challenges[] (Chesterton fence + indefensibility). Leaf inherits root battery (inherit-root). Taxonomy kinds from naming-taxonomy.json. Never encode overturned anti-patterns as forever grammar. Volatile rows live under judgment_files.dir — not inlined here.
judgment_template.anti_stamp_rule: MUST NOT stamp lenses_applied=all-16 with empty or templated challenges[]. Full 16-lens battery is REQUIRED only at root-level keeps/overturns/pattern replacements; leaf rows inherit the parent root battery via lenses_applied=inherit-root and MAY omit repeating all-16 ids. Empty challenges[] with all-16 = REFUSE (northstar-lens-scope).

judgment_files.rule: Volatile judgments (Amendment B rows, naming_sweep) MUST NOT serialize through sole-owner envelopes JSON. Destination integ PRs carry per-unit judgment files in-diff; Claim validates presence when path changes require judgment_status=done.

birth_gate.definition: Freeze birth gate applies ONLY to unit-root births under no_new_births_while_reorg_prefixes: (1) a NEW top-level directory under a freeze prefix that did not exist on origin/dev (e.g. libs/<new-crate>/, cloud/<new-service>/, oya/<new-service>/, tools/<new-kit>/), OR (2) birth of an entirely new freeze-listed prefix. Additive files inside an already-tracked unit root are NOT birth-gated. Freeze ≠ forever home — content must still reorg_now or delete_permanently.
birth_gate.claim_check: deliver.js Claim: for each git diff --diff-filter=A path under freeze prefixes, compute whether it introduces a new unit-root directory absent on origin/dev; REFUSE only those unit-root births without one_shot_exception or reorg-move-out bead.
